title: Watermarking Should Be Treated as a Monitoring Primitive
abstract: arXiv:2605.13095v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Watermarking is a primary means for providers of generative models to meet legal requirements to mark synthetic content. A watermark embeds a hidden signal into generated content that a detector holding a secret key can later recover. Its security is evaluated primarily against adversaries who remove or forge this signal in individual outputs. We argue that watermarking should also be evaluated and governed as a \emph{monitoring primitive}, because the same signal can link outputs to the entity that generated them. We show that (i) internal observers with detector access attribute outputs to individual entities even under zero-bit watermarks, which encode no identity, when each entity holds its own key, and (ii) external observers without keys or detectors identify the source of unseen text and image outputs in the configurations we test. Both depend on deployment choices that evaluations do not report, namely how fine-grained

translated_title: 水印应被视为一种监控原语
translated_abstract: 水印是生成式模型提供商满足合成内容标记法律要求的主要手段。水印将一个隐藏信号嵌入到生成内容中，持有密钥的检测器随后可以恢复该信号。其安全性主要针对的是在单个输出中移除或伪造该信号的对手。我们主张，水印还应作为一种“监控原语”来进行评估和治理，因为同样的信号可以将输出与其生成实体关联起来。我们表明：（i）拥有检测器访问权限的内部观察者即使在零比特水印（即不编码任何身份信息的水印）下，只要每个实体持有自己的密钥，也能将输出归因于具体实体；（ii）在没有密钥或检测器的情况下，外部观察者在我们所测试的配置中也能识别出未见过的文本和图像输出的来源。这两种能力都依赖于评估中未报告的部署选择，即密钥粒度……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 论文主张水印不仅是防御移除和伪造的安全技术，更应被视为一种监控原语——同样的水印信号可用于将生成内容追溯至具体生成实体，即使是零比特水印也能被内部观察者用于个体归因，外部观察者在特定配置下也能识别内容来源。
en_tdlr: The paper argues that watermarking should be evaluated and governed as a monitoring primitive, since the same watermark signal enables output attribution—even zero-bit watermarks allow internal observers with detector access to attribute outputs to individual entities, and keyless external observers can identify the source of unseen text and image outputs in the configurations tested.
